Source inconsistencies kept unresolved at cohort level: ECT sessions "ranged from 10 to 12 (mean: 12.4)" (mean exceeds maximum); "In ten patients, at least one ineffective seizure was recorded" vs 4+3+1 = 8 patients in the breakdown; EEG abnormalities "81.4% of patients (N = 18)" whereas 18/22 = 81.8%. Conclusions state ECT is effective for adolescents "with both psychotic and mood disorders", but the Discussion notes a lack of mood disorder patients and the cohort included only schizophrenia/schizoaffective diagnoses; cohort-level only.
